# Pretraining and the Model Landscape {#sec-pretraining}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- distinguish pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and preference tuning (RLHF/DPO) by their data and objectives;
- explain what scaling laws claim and what they do not;
- navigate the open-vs-closed model landscape and pick a model for a task and budget;
- read a model card critically.
